purpose: Topic library spelling/familiarity audit. It prevents a general dictionary from being mistaken for a topic classifier.

rules.dictionary: The local dwyl list confirms common spelling coverage.
rules.familiarity: wordfreq Zipf score >= 2.6 is a screen for reader-recognizable English words, not a topic label.
rules.automatic_generation: Uses only direct curated topic words; review candidates are never added automatically.

topics.policy: Dictionary spelling is supporting evidence only. Curated direct-topic membership remains required for automatic generation.
